bio: DZ DEATHRAYS ARE A BRISBANE-BORN ROCK BAND WHO’VE SPENT YEARS PERFECTING THE ART OF MAKING VERY LOUD MUSIC THAT’S ALSO RIDICULOUSLY FUN. STARTING OUT AS A TWO-PIECE BUILT AROUND SHANE PARSONS AND SIMON RIDLEY, THEY QUICKLY MADE A NAME FOR THEMSELVES WITH SWEATY HOUSE-PARTY SHOWS, FILTHY GUITAR RIFFS AND SONGS THAT SIT SOMEWHERE BETWEEN PUNK, GARAGE ROCK, THRASH AND STRAIGHT-UP PARTY CHAOS. OVER TIME THE SOUND GOT BIGGER, HEAVIER AND MORE AMBITIOUS WITHOUT LOSING THAT LOOSE, NO-BULLSHIT ENERGY THAT MADE PEOPLE LOVE THEM IN THE FIRST PLACE. THEY’VE RELEASED A STACK OF HARD-HITTING RECORDS, TOURED RELENTLESSLY AROUND AUSTRALIA AND OVERSEAS, PICKED UP ARIA RECOGNITION ALONG THE WAY AND BECOME ONE OF THOSE BANDS YOU REALLY NEED TO SEE LIVE TO FULLY GET. DZ DEATHRAYS ARE BIG RIFFS, SHOUT-ALONG CHORUSES, DISTORTION, SWEAT AND THE FEELING THAT THINGS COULD GET A LITTLE OUT OF HAND AT ANY MOMENT — IN THE BEST POSSIBLE WAY.
